meta.title: Privacy Policy — Velopass
meta.description: Read how Velopass processes and protects your personal data.

sections.title: 1. Who are we?
sections.body: Velopass BV, registered at Stokerijstraat 29/bus a1, 2110 Wijnegem, VAT BE0777.359.681, is the controller for the processing of your personal data through this website and the Velopass services.

sections.title: 2. What data do we collect?
sections.intro: We only collect data that is necessary for our service:
list: Usage data and interactions with our service

sections.title: 3. What do we use your data for?
list: Creating and managing your Velopass account
Statistical analysis to improve our service

sections.title: 4. Cookies

list_rich.label: Functional cookies:
list_rich.body: necessary for the website to work correctly (e.g. session management).

list_rich.label: Analytics cookies:
list_rich.body: help us understand how visitors use our website. These are only set after you give consent.

sections.outro: You can change your cookie preferences at any time via the banner at the bottom of the page.

sections.title: 5. How long do we keep your data?
sections.body: We keep your personal data no longer than necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, unless a longer retention period is required by law. Bike registration data is kept for as long as your account is active.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
list: Have your data corrected or deleted

sections.title: 7. Security
sections.body: We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or theft, including encryption, access control and regular security audits.

sections.title: 8. Contact
sections.intro_prefix: Questions about this privacy policy? Email
